doc: One side of a shape (design/terrain.md, The shape and its sides): its aspect, what stops the player there and what lies beyond, and its ground.

fields.name: edge
fields.doc: What the side is, for the terrain's edge and the boundary beyond it: ledge, ridge, mountain, forest, jungle, sea, or marsh (auto takes the boundary's sectors).

fields.name: height
fields.doc: The ground along the side, metres. It blends along the side into its neighbours' round each corner.

fields.name: rise
fields.doc: How high the land climbs behind it, 0 lowland to 1 the biome's highest peaks (the boundary's).
